name: Oil Moth
description: A ground roamer drawn to the nearest observed Oil within 50 cells. Water and real ledges interrupt its curiosity; a name does not add flight or immunity.

name: Shy Crawler
description: Slow, hesitant ground movement. Water causes an early retreat, and a ledge starts one ten-second retreat whose direction remains latched.

name: Curious Surveyor
description: A more active ground surveyor using the same wander, Oil interest and recovery modules. Short pauses and a home radius keep its exploration local.

name: Idle Mechanic
description: An unhurried local worker. Short activity bouts alternate with longer rests, returning toward its placement and keeping modest separation from other actors.

name: Drifting Flyer
description: For supported two-axis 4LY flight rigs. Seeded drifting, home-relative altitude and boundary retreat use the rig's existing velocity controller; no ground ledge reflex is assigned.

name: Social Roamer
description: A sociable ground roamer attracted to nearby compatible actors, with a comfortable gap and gentle crowd separation. Each authored actor retains its own seed stream.

name: Restless Explorer
description: Prefers nearby unfamiliar space, pauses for novel Oil, tires of repeated discoveries and eventually returns home. High activity depletes its exploration cycle quickly.

name: Territorial Watcher
description: Keeps near its home, briefly watches passing compatible peers and retreats from disliked tags. Add an interest region to give it an authored activity area.

name: Social Drifter
description: Investigates peers, loosely regroups and aligns with copied motion, then disperses after a local congregation. Shared tags affect who attracts it; no private peer intentions are read.

name: Timid Follower
description: Stays at a broad comfortable distance, follows a copied companion or assigned peer and retreats early from Water and disliked actors. Low activity makes its approaches hesitant.

name: Persistent Scavenger
description: Investigates Oil, remembers useful patches, revisits them after a delay and searches briefly after losing sight of them. It tolerates more failed approaches but must eventually withdraw.

name: Routine Patrol
description: Follows four editable offsets around its authored home, pauses at each one and skips a leg after a finite failed attempt. Its low curiosity preserves a recognisable routine.

name: Independent Wanderer
description: Chooses finite seeded destinations without preferring familiar peers. It keeps personal space, tries alternative directions around obstacles and occasionally makes a homeward trip.

name: Cautious Flyer
description: For supported two-axis 4LY rigs. It explores slowly, inspects new Oil, uses observed eight-direction clearance, rests on actual low energy and returns home when its exploration cycle declines.

name: Boundary Grazer
description: For supported two-axis 4LY rigs. Follows an actually sampled Oil boundary tangent, remembers interesting patches, and occasionally leaves the edge for a seeded excursion.

name: Homebody Keeper
description: Takes short local trips, inspects new material without long pursuits and spends finite intervals back at home. Editable activity regions can give it a favourite workplace.
